SELECT c.c_customer_id AS customer_id,
       c.c_first_name AS customer_first_name,
       c.c_last_name AS customer_last_name,
       c.c_email_address AS customer_email_address
FROM customer AS c
JOIN (
    SELECT ss.ss_customer_sk AS customer_sk,
           SUM(CASE WHEN dd.d_year = 1998 THEN ss.ss_ext_list_price - ss.ss_ext_discount_amt END) AS first_year_total,
           SUM(CASE WHEN dd.d_year = 1998 + 1 THEN ss.ss_ext_list_price - ss.ss_ext_discount_amt END) AS second_year_total
    FROM store_sales AS ss
    JOIN date_dim AS dd ON ss.ss_sold_date_sk = dd.d_date_sk
    WHERE dd.d_year IN (1998, 1998 + 1)
    GROUP BY ss.ss_customer_sk
) AS store_totals
    ON c.c_customer_sk = store_totals.customer_sk
   AND store_totals.first_year_total > 0
JOIN (
    SELECT ws.ws_bill_customer_sk AS customer_sk,
           SUM(CASE WHEN dd.d_year = 1998 THEN ws.ws_ext_list_price - ws.ws_ext_discount_amt END) AS first_year_total,
           SUM(CASE WHEN dd.d_year = 1998 + 1 THEN ws.ws_ext_list_price - ws.ws_ext_discount_amt END) AS second_year_total
    FROM web_sales AS ws
    JOIN date_dim AS dd ON ws.ws_sold_date_sk = dd.d_date_sk
    WHERE dd.d_year IN (1998, 1998 + 1)
    GROUP BY ws.ws_bill_customer_sk
) AS web_totals
    ON c.c_customer_sk = web_totals.customer_sk
   AND web_totals.first_year_total > 0
WHERE (CASE WHEN web_totals.first_year_total > 0
            THEN web_totals.second_year_total / web_totals.first_year_total
            ELSE 0.0
       END) >
       (CASE WHEN store_totals.first_year_total > 0
             THEN store_totals.second_year_total / store_totals.first_year_total
             ELSE 0.0
        END)
ORDER BY customer_id,
         customer_first_name,
         customer_last_name,
         customer_email_address
LIMIT 100
